name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-styled-ninjis
title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Ninjis
description:
New Ninji graphics made as an alternative to the ones seen in SMW Redrawn for your Redrawn-styled project needs.

These are made to be closer to the way the Ninjis are depicted in the base Super Mario World, being darkly-clad ninja type baddies that should blend in dark environments (Think Back Door from SMW).

Comes in 3 palette variations, with two further ones based on posing. Read the text file "important information.txt" for further instructions.

Give credit if used.
